title: 云原生资源编排与 AI 应用进展简报
english: Kubernetes 1.37 advances Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA), with DRA Extended Resource support graduating to GA after three releases of development. The release also moves several additional DRA capabilities to Beta or GA and introduces new alpha features. In parallel, OpenAI announced Daybreak for Frontline Defenders, a $1 billion commitment to expand access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services. OpenAI customer stories report that Legora reviewed 41 documents in minutes with GPT-6 Astra and found four planted errors, while Playco reported 50% fewer manual fixes during game prototyping. CNCF also highlighted a zero-downtime migration of a critical Kubernetes deployment from the default namespace and announced OSPO Summit China 2026 in Shanghai.
chinese: 本期重点包括 Kubernetes 1.37 的动态资源分配（DRA）进展：DRA Extended Resource support 已在连续三个版本的建设后晋级 GA，其他能力也进入 Beta 或 GA，并新增一批 Alpha 特性。AI 方面，OpenAI 宣布 Daybreak for Frontline Defenders，承诺投入 10 亿美元，用于扩大关键服务领域对前沿网络安全 AI、培训和支持的获取。OpenAI 发布的客户案例称，Legora 使用 GPT-6 Astra 在数分钟内审阅 41 份文档并发现 4 个预设错误；Playco 则报告称，在游戏原型开发中人工修复减少 50%。CNCF 还介绍了一个将关键 Kubernetes Deployment 从 default namespace 零停机迁移的案例，并预告 2026 年 OSPO Summit China 将在上海举行。
why_it_matters: DRA Extended Resource support 的 GA 进展说明 Kubernetes 对动态、异构资源编排的能力进一步成熟，这与 GPU、加速器及 AI 工作负载的基础设施管理直接相关。零停机迁移案例体现了平台工程对资源治理和变更安全的要求。Daybreak 以及 Legora、Playco 的案例则显示，AIOps、Agent Infra 和面向业务流程的 AI 应用不仅需要模型能力，也需要可靠的调度、权限、评估和运维体系。对资深运维开发而言，掌握 Kubernetes 资源抽象、渐进式发布、无停机变更和 AI 工作流工程，有助于连接云原生平台与 AI 生产化。
interview_expression: I focus on making AI workloads reliable in production by combining Kubernetes resource management with safe, observable change processes. I also evaluate automation by its operational impact, not only by model capability.

vocabulary.example: Dynamic Resource Allocation helps Kubernetes handle specialized resource requests.
The feature graduated to GA after several releases of development.
The team completed a zero-downtime migration of a critical Kubernetes deployment.

sources.title: Kubernetes v1.37: DRA Updates
sources.summary:
Kubernetes 1.37 is here and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) keeps pushing past where it started! This release brings DRA Extended Resource support to GA, a milestone the team has been building toward for three straight releases. Several more features graduate to Beta or GA. A fresh batch of alpha features rounds out the release.

I'll dive into what's new for DRA in Kubernetes 1.37!
